about_the_game:
Sample the new foundations that set the stage for your managerial career across six in-game months with the Football Manager 26 Demo.

Start a single-player career and immerse yourself in a world of unparalleled depth and realism. Built on the Unity engine, FM26 is legacy, redefined and where storytelling evolves.

New, volumetric player animations from real football matches, improved graphics across every aspect of Match Day and reactive crowd audio heighten the drama of those all-important victories.

Experience the unmatched atmosphere of the Premier League, now fully licensed and delivered with that iconic broadcast presentation for the first time in the franchise.

Explore an entirely new world of possibilities and break new ground with the introduction of Women's Football, elevated by headline licenses across the biggest leagues.

A game-changing user interface places a world of knowledge at your fingertips and gives you more control over the way you play and the decisions that define your club’s future success.

Once you’ve reached the six-month limit, upgrade to continue your career and define your footballing destiny. In FM26 football belongs to you and your vision.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 11 Big Sur, 12 Monterey, 13 Ventura, 14 Sonoma, 15 Sequoia - with updates
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Desktop: Apple M1 or NVIDIA GeForce GT 750M or Intel HD Graphics 5000 or AMD FirePro D300 Laptop: Apple M1 or NVIDIA GeForce GT 750M or Intel HD Graphics 5000
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 13 Ventura, 14 Sonoma, 15 Sequoia – with updates
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GiB VRAM, Apple M1
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

name: Football Manager 26 Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (with updates 22H2), Windows 11 (with updates 23H2)
  • Processor: Desktop: Intel Core i3-530 or AMD FX-4100 Laptop: Intel Core i3-330M or AMD A6-5200 Requires SSE4.2 & SSSE3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Desktop: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380 or Intel HD 530 Laptop: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960M or AMD Radeon R9 M375 or Intel HD 530 512MiB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 – with updates (23H2)
  • Processor: Desktop: Intel Core i5-9600 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Laptop: Intel Core i5-1035G7 or AMD Ryzen 7 3750H
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Desktop: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT Laptop: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 Mobile or AMD Radeon RX 6600M
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management with the Football Manager 26 Demo. Take charge for six in-game months, and explore game-changing upgrades that take you to the heart of the beautiful game.
